Name: Turn Pam into a Horse
Author: RatsWithPants
Description:
[size=6][size=6]Everyone knows the legend of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3887]Pam as a Horse﻿[/url]...[/size][size=3] [/size]
[size=4]but, well, why should Pam get to stay as an NPC while also replacing the horse?[/size]

[size=3]With this mod, not only can Pam become your trusty horse, but your trusty horse can become Pam!
[/size][size=3]Penny is happier this way. Trust me, I asked.[/size]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/6cGp9iC.png[/img][/b][/size]

[size=4]All assets were made by me and/or directly edited from vanilla assets. This is my first time making a mod for Stardew Valley and also my first time seriously attempting pixel art (and my first time trying to draw a horse). It [i]should[/i]  work properly, but I also have no idea what I'm doing, so it might not. Sorry in advance![/size]

Manifest.Description: It turns Pam into a horse.
